text: The UTF-8 and Latin-1 ICS fixtures both represent Event Två. Their final character has bytes c3 a5 and e5 respectively. The importer test loads both files and checks that title survives decoding. Re-saving both fixtures as UTF-8 would remove the tested distinction while leaving the displayed text unchanged. The source diff itself contains a non-UTF-8 byte; the evidence preserves raw Base64 and hashes instead of treating its replacement character as original text. No importer test executed.
title: Keep encoding fixtures as actual bytes rather than visually identical text
